body.x: The world's largest technology exhibition 'CES 2019' is being held in Las Vegas from January 8th to Thursday 11th, and the start-up of Korea to participate in CES start up Eureka Park will be held.

The CES is hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), a marketplace for businesses promoting brands from around the world. It is a global exhibition where everyone in the technology industry is gathering, and it is a high-level business event that encompasses various industries. Especially, Eureka Park, which is a start-up zone in CES, is attracting attention from investors, media and participating companies around the world.

CES Eureka Park is growing by more than 30%every year and is participating in a joint project in countries that activelysupport start-ups. More than 1,000 startups from 45 countries participated inthe 'CES 2018' Eureka Park. CES 2019 will have a larger Eureka park than lastyear's show.

"AVING News" and "Global MICE Expert Group", "GMEG," which advertise Korean companies the most in the world, are organizing 'MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT' in Eureka Park and recruiting representative start-ups of Korea. This is part of a project to help Korean start-ups advance into the global market.

Considering the advantages of CES, which isnot a traditional joint venture, we plan to expose promising start-ups toinvestors, buyers and media through a variety of programs includingparticipation strategy consulting, public relations marketing, and networkingparties. Also, on the third day of the exhibition, the company will hold a"MIK Innovation Night" party to invite investors and media thatcompanies have met to establish a business networking space.

Global companies and investors are eagerlylooking for new technology and investment opportunities through Eureka Park,which is a start-up of CES. It is time for domestic companies to participateactively. Global stage to form a new partnership CES2019 'MIK INNOVATION HOTSPOT' can be inquired about as Global MICE Expert Group 'GMEG'.

Meanwhile, 'CES', the largest IT exhibition in the world, is an exhibition that can grasp the flow of the home electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. A global news network that most recently reported the issues of CES, MWC and IFA, the world's top three tech exhibitions over the last twelve years, has sent a special report team to CES this year to report major issues in the world market.
